nodes.name: Mock Response
nodes.notes:
CLIENT IMPLEMENTATION:

Input: {
  agent_id: string
}

Output: {
  code: 200 | 404 | 500,
  data?: {
    system_prompt: string,
    model: string,
    tools?: string[],
    temperature?: number,
    max_tokens?: number,
    [key: string]: any (additional LLM config)
  }
}

Implementation:
- Query agent configuration by ID
- Return 404 if agent not found
- Include system prompt with client-specific instructions
- Specify model to use (gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4, etc.)
- Provide dynamic configuration per agent
